narrative.overview:
Topic Stream is a calm, direct control surface for a personal information-retrieval system. Its
visual authority is the user-pinned reference at
`.artifacts/storybook-review/design-reference.png`, sourced from the approved
[Dribbble image](https://cdn.dribbble.com/userupload/12942608/file/original-4c287785698d505006c3f207a6b77987.png?resize=2048x1536&vertical=center).
The implementation translates that reference into black and charcoal work areas, lighter matte
fields, clear host typography, rounded work zones, and a soft peach action language. The reference
is a direction anchor, not a pixel-bound asset or a generated concept.

The production shell is code-led and retains Obsidian's interface and reading typography. Real
ConnectedShell and production screen compositions render in Storybook; external services and data
are mocked at their ports, and English/Spanish fixtures are synthetic demonstrations. The shipped
slice includes the Feed's independent All Topics/Topic traversals, persisted All/Unread filtering,
direct-title reading and explicit Item details, immediate feedback with optional notes, visibility,
and Topic corrections, the quiet Search + Filters flow, and the canonical Reader with full-body
Markdown, consent-gated images, and an explicit shared AI Summary disclosure. Sources, Topics,
Digest definitions, Workspace, Preferences, and Status remain available as management surfaces.
The Reader preserves title-first hierarchy and Item-scoped notices; Search keeps text-led rows,
anchored filters, UTC date bounds, 20-result pages, and a 100-result session cap. UI 08 also ships
the connected Digest archive, saved Edition with compact contents and captured Reader, saved-definition
Build and results, device-scoped New Issue badges, and the Task Center's shared Job progress,
Cancel/Retry actions, and model-recovery context. Device-scoped readiness establishes a baseline from
the first successful unfiltered archive head once per device/backend/Workspace; subsequent mount or
manual REST reads reconstruct unopened post-baseline Issues without emitting catch-up Notices. Live
Notice/event consumers share a view-owned browser SSE transport and deduplicate across views.
Reconnect reconciles REST without publication, generation or global offline chrome; failed streams
retain content and explicit Refresh. UI 09 also ships one native protected-focus Save to vault form from
Item and captured Digest Item overflow menus plus the whole-Issue actions menu. It normalizes paths,
remembers Compact/Full and Full-only image choices per vault, requires explicit mixed-Digest consent,
and keeps validation, pending, and write errors contextual. Ready matching AI annotations are
captured without generating, waiting, retrying, or mirroring later work; safe bounded Vault/FileManager
writes preserve links, sanitize SVG, reject overwrites, and roll back only newly created attachments.
keyCharacteristics: Black/charcoal work areas with pale light-mode equivalents and no decorative gradients.
Matte fields and rounded work zones, with translucent blur reserved for anchored menus, note panels, editor panes, and the Feed header while its list is scrolled.
A soft peach selection and action color (`#F2B38A`) with a lighter hover (`#F7C5A6`).
Host-native interface and reading type, a restrained spacing rhythm, and equal light/dark care.
One clear action per view; secondary operations stay in real anchored menus.
Title-first Reader content with bounded prose, local scrolling for code/tables, and quiet source headings beneath the Item title.
Consent-gated matte image placeholders and local recovery states; AI Summary remains explicit, version-bound, and readable when ready.
View-owned browser Fetch/ReadableStream SSE keeps invalidations advisory, reconciles REST on reconnect, and retains loaded content without a persistent offline banner.
Primary navigation wraps complete controls, while Settings headings/resource actions wrap as groups and narrow resource panels stretch to the available width.
Digest archive rows, Edition sections, compact contents, and captured Reader preserve the same text-led hierarchy while New badges identify unseen saved Issues.
Task Center keeps Job status, progress, history facts, Cancel/Retry, and model recovery in the shared shell rather than turning background work into a dashboard.
Snapshot saves use a native peach form for normalized paths, explicit content/image choices, mixed-result consent, and contextual recovery while restoring focus to the invoking overflow action.

rules.name: The Purposeful Peach Rule
rules.body: Peach marks a current action, selected row, checked state, or focus; it is not a decorative wash across every title or surface. Host-native semantic warning colors may still appear for errors.

rules.name: The One Focal Title Rule
rules.body: Give the current page or opened Item one clear title. Supporting metadata and controls stay quieter; hierarchy does not require inventing an editorial headline or an unsupported intelligence claim.

rules.name: The Real Overlay Rule
rules.body: Use depth to clarify an anchored menu, note, dialog, or editor pane. Do not add shadows around every reading row or turn a matte field into a floating card.

rules.name: The Status-Authority Rule
rules.body: Treat the Job status label as the outcome; the progress bar only describes the observed initial cohort. Never infer success from a full bar or a count alone.

rules.name: The Protected Save Rule
rules.body: Snapshot Save stays an explicit, native, focus-protected action: normalize and reject paths before writing, preserve captured content, and keep mixed consent, pending, and failures visible without generating or waiting for AI work.

dos: derive new surfaces from the black/charcoal work-area hierarchy and the light-mode pale equivalent; keep fields matte and readable.
reserve `#F2B38A` and `#F7C5A6` for action, selection, checked/pressed, hover, and focus states; retain the light-theme accent ink where contrast requires it.
preserve host typography, theme switching, keyboard focus, `44px` coarse-pointer targets, and the `48em` leaf breakpoint.
keep menus, filters, and note panels anchored to their trigger, with panel fallback colors when blur is unavailable and `blur(28px)` only when supported.
keep the Feed header opaque at rest and use the existing glass token with `blur(12px)` only while its list is scrolled; preserve the opaque fallback and the `32px` header clearance.
preserve the Reader's title-first hierarchy, `70ch` prose measure, local code/table scroll, consent-gated images, and exact-version explicit summary disclosure.
keep Search text-led with quiet Search + Filters controls, UTC date semantics, 20-result pages, and a 100-result session limit.
keep Digest archive and Edition surfaces text-led, preserve compact contents and captured Reader return/focus, and show New Issue badges only for unseen device-scoped saved Issues.
keep Task Center and Settings on shared Job queries; use peach normal progress, muted failed/cancelled history, and explicit Cancel/Retry/model recovery actions.

keep view-owned browser Fetch/ReadableStream SSE advisory: bind reconnect and pop-out lifecycle to the active view, reconcile REST authoritatively, and retain loaded content plus explicit Refresh when streaming is unavailable.
keep Snapshot saves portable and explicit: normalize paths, reject existing destinations, preserve captured content, honor image budgets and SVG sanitation, and restore focus to the invoking action.
keep ready AI annotations source-version-bound in Compact or Full without generating, waiting, retrying, or mirroring later work; show mixed consent and Excerpt only labels when needed.
keep one clear action per view and use explicit text for unfamiliar distinctions.
keep Storybook evidence connected to production components, mocking only external service ports and using synthetic English/Spanish demonstration data.
donts: invent a competing palette or direction, or treat the pinned reference as a source of random generated comps.
add decorative gradients, glowing edges, ornamental glass, nested card borders, or shadows around every row.
replace real anchored menus with a permanent inline Add a note control, a modal note editor, or a row of outlined secondary actions.

claim physical mobile-device parity from responsive frames, browser dependency checks or desktop host tests; browser Fetch/ReadableStream SSE and native desktop main/pop-out lifecycle are shipped and verified, while physical iOS/Android streaming remains untested.
silently save an excerpt under Full, show Full-only image controls when an individual Item has no full text, overwrite an existing path, or imply that linked/failed images were stored locally.
trigger Summary generation, waiting, Retry, or late note mutation from Snapshot Save; capture only a ready annotation matching the saved Item input version.
infer Job success from `N / N`; preserve separate peach normal and muted failed/cancelled progress history fills with the status label as the authority.
fetch thumbnails before image consent, turn a ready summary into a generated headline, or display summary text from a different source version.
claim excerpts are generated summaries or add unsupported intelligence, KPI, ETA, or operator-tuning UI.
use the exploratory raster as a pixel-bound asset; keep the implementation code-led and preserve its provenance.
